from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Literal, Optional

class HousingMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single housing metric record with its percentage change and reliability status."""
    name: Literal[
        "total housing starts",
        "single-family housing starts",
        "housing starts for buildings with five or more units",
        "total housing permits",
        "single-family housing permits",
        "housing permits for buildings with two to four units",
        "housing permits for buildings with five or more units",
        "total housing completions"
    ] = Field(..., description="The name of the metric as defined in the task")
    change_percent: Optional[float] = Field(..., description="Month-over-month percentage change (e.g., -10.0, +5.5)")
    is_reliable: Optional[bool] = Field(..., description="False if data is marked 'S' (unreliable), True otherwise. None if not mentioned")

class MonthRecord(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted for a single month, including source release date for precedence."""
    month: str = Field(..., description="The month the data refers to, formatted YYYY-MM")
    report_release_date: str = Field(..., description="Release date of the document providing this data, formatted YYYY-MM-DD")
    metrics: List[HousingMetric] = Field(..., description="The list of the 8 metrics reported for this month")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated list of monthly records from all documents."""
    monthly_records: List[MonthRecord]
